status: DEVELOPMENT — authored before the profile change, by the session that builds it. Not held-out evidence.
purpose: Temporal consistency of the profile / identity / cognitive model: endings, replacements, departures, relocation, partial changes, goal completion, preference change, resolved blocker, moved deadline, historical questions — and controls that must NOT change anything (negated, speculative, hypothetical-future statements).

sessions: I'm employed at Hartwell Bank as a risk analyst.
I resigned from Hartwell last Friday.

required: he resigned from Hartwell; no current employer stated
forbidden: he currently works at Hartwell Bank

sessions: My car is a 2012 Honda Civic.
I sold the Civic and bought a used Tesla Model 3.

forbidden: a 2012 Honda Civic is his current car

sessions: I live in Leeds.
We relocated to Bristol in June.
My biggest client is Oakline.
Now Mellow is my biggest client; they doubled my contract.

forbidden: Oakline is the current biggest client
